## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `81eae9ab9bf7e203dc0531557439ce71d8fa171c`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: no

Read: the PR body and its diff against merge base `01889892` (6 files, +89/-28, two branch commits); cards #34962, #35097, #34053, #34546 with every comment, the dev report 6998622390, card #34030 and its comments; ruling record 6513306068 (on #27847); the two skill files and both eval files whole at head; the code the new sentences describe, at head; the skill-evals runner; the check-runs on this head. File sizes and token occurrences were read off git blobs. No repo script, build, test or gate was run.

Check-runs on this head (45 runs, all completed): 29 success, 16 skipped, 0 failed, 0 in progress. Success includes Build Core, Test Core and its 3 planned shards, TypeScript Type Check with its four parts, Lint & Repo Gates and all eight Lint parts, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard. Skipped are the UI build/test/lint families, Build Docs, Temporal Conformance, the opt-in harnesses and the queue verdicts. The PR is a draft, `mergeable_state: clean`, no auto-merge armed. Main has moved 7 commits past the merge base (now `11345191`); none touches the six paths or any file cited below, and the merge is clean.

### ① Derived judgments

Every new sentence, against the code at head:

- `mappings` group, `mappings.{mapping}.label` keyed by the mapping's `name`, label only: RIGHT. `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:2359-2370` (one key, `label`; its guidance refuses `description`); `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts:411-412` (`name`, `label`, no description key); served by `translateMapping`, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:2995-3045`, registered at `:2049`; walked for extract and check at `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts:2175-2181`, so "extract `--no-objects-only` scaffolds every group above" stays true with `mappings` in the list. The zh-CN example is the shipped spelling: `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts:1554`.
- `hooks.{hook}.texts.{key}.message` and `_actions.{action_name}.texts.{key}.message`, also under `globalActions`: RIGHT. `translation.zod.ts:398-411` (one factory for both), `:498-503`, `:783`, `:1316`, `:2207`, `:2260`; the keys are spelled by `hookTextMessageKey` and `actionTextMessageKey` (`i18n-resolver.ts:4651`, `:4700`).
- "picked in the organization's language (the Localization setting if set, else `i18n.defaultLocale`; never the caller's)": RIGHT for all three writers. `packages/core/src/organization-locale.ts:109-116` (setting, else the app default) and `:185-198` (the one reader the flow record write, a hook text and an action text share); `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.ts:147`; spec text at `translation.zod.ts:2236-2242`. "never the run starter's" became "never the caller's": same fact for a flow, and the automation skill (`SKILL.md:271-272`) still says it its own way. No contradiction.
- `rules/actions.md` new H3: RIGHT, sentence by sentence. Same actions as `refusals` (a `script` action with a `js` body, anything else refused the key): `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:2673-2678`. The `texts` literal and the `await ctx.text('email_subject', { subject: input.subject })` call are the spec's and the docs' own example (`action.zod.ts:1556-1560`, `content/docs/ui/actions.mdx:197-215`). No translation writes the declared sentence, filled: `hook-text.ts:148-162`. An unreadable Localization setting rejects: `organization-locale.ts:143-157` (only an unregistered setting reads as unset; any other throw propagates) through the un-caught await at `hook-text.ts:147`. Undeclared key refused at save when literal, else at run: `action.zod.ts:2679-2685` and `hook-text.ts:143-146`. Installed on the action body at `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/body-runner.ts:689`.
- `sourceLocale` row, "a request in it is served that text": RIGHT. `i18n-resolver.ts:61-66` and `:355-377`; the serving layer passes `getSourceLocale()` first, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:3286-3298`. One qualifier the row does not carry and need not: a shipped source-locale bundle row still wins (`i18n-resolver.ts:374-375`).
- The deleted reminder was stale: RIGHT. It said label serving reads inline text as `defaultLocale` text. Commit `2068e037` (#34025), an ancestor of this head, made the five serving readers treat `i18n.sourceLocale` as the authored language (same cites as the row above, plus `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts:2875-2890`).
- The kept `t()` sentence and eval case 11: RIGHT on this head and on main `11345191`. `resolveFieldLabel` asks the translator before the declared label (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts:463-482`); the translator is `II18nService.t` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-validation-messages.ts:80-88`); `FileI18nAdapter.t()` tries the requested locale, then its fallback (`packages/services/service-i18n/src/file-i18n-adapter.ts:174-194`); `os serve` builds it with `fallbackLocale || defaultLocale || 'en'` (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts:4032-4035`). So with `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, `sourceLocale: 'en'` and no `fallbackLocale`, an `en` refusal reads the zh-CN row; with `fallbackLocale: 'en'` the miss echoes the key and the declared English label answers. #34030 is open (`pm:queue`), and main's 7 new commits touch none of these files.
- The i18n same-file payments lost no instruction: RIGHT. The renamed-target sentence described a symptom; the gate that catches it (`translation-target-unknown`, an error) stays one paragraph up. `--objects-only` and `--source-hashes` left the "rest of `--help`" list and are each still taught in place (the default-on warning; the Register comment). The two partial group lists gave way to "the other groups", with `--no-objects-only` and "author them by hand" kept. "2. Translate / Fill in the values manually" carried no rule; no link names the renumbered heading.
- Ratchet arithmetic: RIGHT. `actions.md` 12720 to 13335 bytes, `ceil(13335 / 4) = 3334`, zero headroom before, +154; the new H3 is 644 bytes and the refusals paragraph shrank 213 to 184 (29). i18n `SKILL.md` 25325 to 25336 bytes, priced without its 20-byte stamp line 6327 to 6329, row untouched at 6333.
- The `actions.md` 29-byte cut lost no instruction for a reader of the whole catalog (objectstack-i18n keeps the `_actions.{action_name}.refusals.{CODE}` row), but it removed the only spelling of `_actions` in the objectstack-ui bundle, which that bundle's own evals assert: WRONG as landed. See ④ M1.

### ② Semver level

- `'@objectstack/skills': patch`: RIGHT. The diff changes served skill text, eval fixtures and one unpublished script row. Check Changeset is green.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: RIGHT, judged by what the shipped agent is taught. `mappings`, hook `texts` and action `texts` were added to the protocol by their own carriers (#34939, #34545, #35085); this diff changes nothing a metadata author can write, it teaches what is already accepted.
- `Clause-②: no`: RIGHT. No published accept set moves. What the agent is no longer taught is one false caveat, four restatements, one empty step and one bundle key now reached through a pointer; none of it narrows what an author may write.
- Both declaration lines are in the PR body and in the changeset body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1, #34546 is "Part of": ACCEPTED. The automation skill does not teach hooks: its description sends object-layer lifecycle hooks to objectstack-data (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:8-10`), and its only hook passage is the `runAs` note (`:211-217`). Hooks are taught in `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, which open draft #34964 holds. The PR body names the missing half (declaration, `ctx.text`, missing-key behaviour for hooks, one data eval); the card stays open as its carrier.
- Dev deviations 2 and 3 (a stopped first gate run, the lint-closure build): no effect on the diff; CI is green on this head.
- `open_questions`: none raised.
- Out-of-scope note "#34030, noted, not filed": see ④ N6.
- Card asks. #34962: met (group list, one example, i18n case 14). #34053: met (caveat removed, row rewritten, case 11 keeps `fallbackLocale: 'en'` with a true reason, decision stated). #34546: i18n half met and the rest declared. #35097: both texts carry it; its one eval case is ④ M1.
- The p3 rides legitimately: #34053 edits the same `SKILL.md` and its eval file, four cards in all, under the maintainer's 「顺带做的 p3 可以」 quoted in the claim.
- Ruling B (record 6513306068, point 2): the form is met. The body quotes 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 verbatim and names the record; a same-file deletion is shown; the row moves by the measured remainder and is pinned at the measurement. +154 for one new authorable key is in line with the +149 its twin `refusals` took. Whether the deletion stands is ④ M1.
- Serial: open draft #34970 edits the same i18n `SKILL.md` (+4/-1) and this head leaves 4 tokens of headroom; whichever lands second re-measures.
- The security line above reads no because no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour. The hunks teach a translation group, bundle keys, which language a written sentence takes, a locale fallback, and a refused undeclared key (a validation refusal). The "bodies execute trusted" line in `actions.md` is unchanged context.
- SQL push-down: no code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

One must-fix, on the eval fixtures. The teaching text itself holds against the code.

- M1 (must-fix) — two objectstack-ui eval assertions now require a token their bundle no longer contains. `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` case 21 (new here) and case 20 (landed with #35087) both carry `_actions` in `must_contain`. At base the bundle taught it once, `rules/actions.md:141`, the bundle key this PR cut to pay 29 bytes. At head a search of `skills/objectstack-ui` outside `evals/` finds no `_actions` at all, and the new H3 says "(keys: objectstack-i18n)". The runner gives a with-skill turn the case's own bundle and nothing else (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/arms.ts:86-100`: one `cpSync` of `skillsRoot/bundle`, tools Read/Glob/Grep/Skill in a fresh directory) and grades by literal substring (`grade.ts:27-29`). So an answer written from the ui skill cannot contain `_actions`: case 21, the one eval #35097 asks for, cannot pass on the with-skill arm, and case 20 goes from answerable to unanswerable. Across the catalog these are the only two `must_contain` tokens that sit in neither their bundle's markdown nor their own prompt at head and did not already at base. Fix, either way: (a) drop `_actions` from both lists and let the two `expected_output` texts say the sentence is translated under the action's keys taught by objectstack-i18n (i18n case 13 already asserts the refusal key there; widen i18n case 15 or add a case if the action-node `texts` key should stay graded); or (b) keep the key spelled in `rules/actions.md`, in which case the 29-byte payment is gone and the row cannot move under letter B without another same-file deletion. Under (a) the cut is a fair teach-once payment and the +154 stands.

Per file, otherwise:

- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: holds. An agent asked to translate a mapping label, a hook text or an action text now finds the key and whose language picks it; an agent configuring an English-source app for Chinese users is no longer told serving ignores `sourceLocale`, and is still told the one case where `fallbackLocale: 'en'` matters.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`: holds as text. It teaches the declaration, the call and the three run-time answers, and leaves the keys to the skill that owns them.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`: cases 14 and 15 test what the new text teaches; case 11 matches the rewritten caveat. No `must_not_contain` entry occurs in its own `expected_output`.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the row and its note agree with the measured file; the note's claim depends on M1's route.

Nits (none blocks):

- N1 — ui case 21 forbids `'Email: ' +`, a string its own prompt hands the answerer; an answer that quotes the old line while replacing it fails. Narrow it or drop it.
- N2 — i18n case 15 requires `{{ lead }}`, so an answer that names the key and the language without a sample translation fails; the i18n text teaches kept holes only for refusal entries. Its `expected_output` also says "with no translation the declared sentence is written", which no file of the i18n bundle teaches yet (not asserted).
- N3 — the top-level group list still omits `hooks`, though the file now spells `hooks.{hook}.…` keys twice and the spec counts it among seventeen groups (`translation.zod.ts:1070-1072`). Pre-existing; fits the #34546 remainder.
- N4 — `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:85` cues `refusals` for `rules/actions.md` but not `texts`.
- N5 — i18n case 5's `expected_output` still recites the kind list the `--objects-only` paragraph no longer carries; its assertions are unaffected.
- N6 — #34030's body does not name the skill sentence (`SKILL.md:51-53`) or case 11. If its PR declares `Metadata-protocol: none` no `Skills-docs:` line is owed and the caveat goes stale the way #34053's did. One comment on #34030 naming both places carries it.
- N7 — the changeset body does not mention the five i18n same-file deletions (prose face, the seat's ACCEPT).

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `14899df1c2c7c4e9ad221d8d209825f745ca5ffc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json, skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: no

Delta round. Round 1 is record 6999139326 on head `81eae9ab9bf7e203dc0531557439ce71d8fa171c`: FAIL on one must-fix (M1), seven nits. This record reads the one commit since, `14899df1c2` (5 files, +30/-26), and stands on round 1 for everything that commit does not touch.

Read: the delta diff and its commit message; the three changed skill and eval files whole at this head; the row note; the PR body as it stands now; the PR diff against main (`00cfb78f`, 10 commits past the merge base `01889892`); the code the two shortened sentences describe; the cards' threads since round 1 (no new comment). File sizes and token occurrences were read off git blobs. No repo script, build, test or gate was run.

Check-runs on this head, read at 2026-11-19T04:04Z, CI still running: 47 runs, 26 success, 18 skipped, 0 failed, 3 in progress. PENDING: `Test Core (1/10)`, `Test Core (2/10)`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`. Not yet reported on this head, and green on the round 1 head: the two roll-ups `Test Core` and `Lint & Repo Gates`. Already green here: Build Core, Test Core (3/10), TypeScript Type Check with its four parts, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, the three scoped lints, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard. The PR is a draft, `mergeable_state: blocked`, no auto-merge armed. This verdict covers the text and the evals; it does not stand in for the pending runs.

### ① Derived judgments

- M1 is closed: RIGHT. `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:140-142` is byte-identical to base again and spells `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.refusals.CODE.message`; it is the one `_actions` in the bundle outside `evals/`. Case 20 is answerable from that line. The new H3 says the text is "translated at the same node's `texts.KEY.message`" (`:150`), so case 21's key composes from the two lines of its own bundle. The claim is true: `refusals` and `texts` are sibling keys of one action translation schema (`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts:497-503`, `:781-783`). Catalog-wide, the `must_contain` tokens that sit in neither their bundle's markdown nor their own prompt are the same set at this head as at base; this PR adds none.
- Cut A, " as `${result.output.NAME}`" in the `onSuccess` sentence (27 bytes): a true restatement, no instruction lost. The sentence still says the URL template reads an `isOutput` variable (`actions.md:67`) and the block it introduces spells `${result.output.opportunity_id}` (`:85`). Eval case 8, which requires `result.output`, still finds it in the bundle.
- Cut B, "`{recordId}` placeholder; " in the `newTabUrl` sentence (26 bytes): a restatement of the example, no instruction lost. `newTabUrl: '/api/v1/invoice/{recordId}/pdf'` (`:196`) carries the spelling, which is the whole rule (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:2320`; the console replaces that literal, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/consoleServerAction.ts:247`). It is the thinner of the two, see ④ D2. No eval asserts the removed words.
- Both cuts are same-file restatement of the kind this row has paid with before (the #34824 note: "the examples show the shape"); main's #35294 paid the platform row under the same ruling the same way.
- Ratchet: RIGHT. `actions.md` is 12720 bytes at base and 13330 here, `ceil(13330 / 4) = 3333`, zero headroom before, +153. The file at this head equals base with the two fragments removed and the 663-byte H3 inserted, nothing else. The row is pinned at 3333 (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:1442`) and its note's numbers match. The i18n `SKILL.md` is byte-identical to round 1 (priced 6329, ceiling 6333, row untouched).
- Ruling B (record 6513306068, point 2): the form holds and is now cleaner. The PR body quotes 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」 verbatim with the record id and the measured +153; both deletions are in the file whose row moves and each restates a passage of that same file.
- The reworded H3 is still true sentence by sentence against the cites of round 1 ①; "read organization-wide" and "refused at save when named literally, else at run" change no claim.
- On main's new tip the merge is clean. Main's #35294 edits the ratchet file on the platform row only; the merged tree keeps `actions.md` at 13330 bytes under 3333 and the i18n file at 6329 under 6333. None of main's 10 commits touches the code cited in either round.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged and still RIGHT: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, both lines in the PR body and the changeset. Check Changeset is green on this head.
- The changeset body's two edited bullets match the diff: the ui bullet no longer says the refusals paragraph only points at the i18n skill, and a new bullet names the i18n same-file deletions (round 1 N7).

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev claim "fix (b)": CONFIRMED, see ① first bullet.
- Dev claim "paid by two same-file fragments, 53 bytes": CONFIRMED, 27 + 26.
- Dev claim "N1, N2, N7 taken": CONFIRMED. ui case 21 no longer forbids `'Email: ' +`; i18n case 15 no longer requires `{{ lead }}` and its `expected_output` drops the sentence no i18n file teaches; the changeset names the deletions. Both eval files parse; no `must_not_contain` entry of a changed case occurs in its own `expected_output`.
- Dev claim "N3 to N6 not taken": ACCEPTED as deviations, none affects correctness. N3 (`hooks` absent from the top-level group list) fits the #34546 remainder. N4 (router cue for `texts`) and N5 (i18n case 5's reference answer) stand as written. N6 is the seat's: one comment on #34030 naming `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:51-53` and eval case 11.
- Card asks: unchanged from round 1, and #35097's one eval case is now answerable from its bundle. #34546 stays "Part of".
- The security line above reads no because nothing the delta changes teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour. One thing for the adopting seat to see: cut B edits the `newTabUrl` sentence, whose tail says the endpoint enforces its own auth. That clause, and "an external URL is refused", are byte-identical at base and at this head; only the placeholder note left. The PR is Tier H in any case: it moves a ratchet ceiling.
- Serial: open draft #34970 still edits the same i18n `SKILL.md` with 4 tokens of headroom left; whichever lands second re-measures.
- SQL push-down: no code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix and no should-fix on this head. The fix took the route that keeps the bundle self-sufficient for its own evals, and paid for it with deletions that are restatement in the strict sense.

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`: holds. An agent writing a `script` action finds the declaration, the call, the three run-time answers and both bundle keys in one place.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: cases 20 and 21 test what their bundle teaches.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`: case 15 asserts only what the i18n text teaches.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the row agrees with the measured file and with its note.

Nits (none blocks, none needs a push):

- D1 — "the same node" in the `texts` sentence has its antecedent across the heading (the refusals key one paragraph up), and the `texts` sentence no longer points at objectstack-i18n itself, so the `globalActions` home of an object-less action's text is reached only through the refusals sentence's pointer.
- D2 — after cut B the Open PDF example is the only place the bundle shows `{recordId}`, a convention unlike the `${…}` holes of `target` and `onSuccess` in the same file (`action.zod.ts:2256-2258`). A later edit of that example must keep it.
- D3 — the row note again says "Nothing else in the file restates another passage", which this round and the #34824 round each disproved. Comment only.
- PR body — the full local gate union is reported for the round 1 head and a subset for this one; CI covers the rest once it finishes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:i18n 技能顶层分组加 `mappings`;组织语言段覆盖钩子/动作的 `texts` 键;删一条已失效的「标签按内联文字服务」提醒,保留仍成立的 `t()` 一句;UI 技能 `rules/actions.md` 新增 `texts` + `ctx.text` 小节,恢复 `refusals` 键的完整写法。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · repo:objectstack#5 · head `14899df1c2c7c4e9ad221d8d209825f745ca5ffc` · 2026-11-19T04:06Z

- **形态:** 6 files, +92/−27; governed `skills/**` plus the ratchet script → Tier H. `Fixes #34962`, `Fixes #35097`, `Fixes #34053` (p3 riding the same file, ≤5 cards), `Part of #34546`. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, changeset patch. Claim 6998030235.

Ratchet 13330 bytes → 3333 under ruling 6513306068 letter B. `Security-touching: no`.

- **落地条款:** Tier H. K = 10 first-parent commits on `main` since merge base `01889892` (< 15). This stroke: `pm:awaiting-merge` + reviewers os-zhuang, hotlong. After approval and green CI the seat lands; on MERGED close-out on #34962, #35097, #34053, and #34546 stays open (`Part of`).
